Question: does the app STORE activity data in Firestore, or just use it ephemerally to interpret heart rate? If ephemeral, no need to declare. If stored, needs Fitness info checked.

data_safety_form.fitness_info: Do NOT check - heart rate falls under Health info, not Fitness info. Fitness info is for exercise/workout tracking.
data_safety_form.health_info_marked_optional: CORRECT - users can decline body sensors and still use reminders, calendar, location.

android_manifest.issue: Duplicate com.google.android.wearable.standalone meta-data tag. One in <application> set to false, one inside <activity> set to true. Remove the one inside <activity>.
android_manifest.wear_os_note: wear_plus is Dart-only, no separate wear/ module. Single AAB covers both phone and Wear OS. Same bundle uploaded to both phone and Wear OS tabs in Play Console.

permissions_declarations.BODY_SENSORS: Used exclusively on Wear OS to read heart rate from smartwatch sensor. Used in real time to detect abnormal readings and alert caregiver. Not stored permanently.
permissions_declarations.ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION: Used on Wear OS to detect patient movement alongside heart rate monitoring. Helps avoid false alerts by providing activity context.
permissions_declarations.health_READ_HEART_RATE: Used on Wear OS to access heart rate data. Sole purpose is real-time patient safety monitoring and caregiver alerts for abnormal readings.
